visualCharacteristics: Single-column stacked rows, text left, thumbnail right, divider lines; Load More button below

contentPattern.rows: One row per card, plus an optional final row holding only a 'Load More' link
cells: Date paragraph; H3 title link; 'By: <author>' paragraph; teaser paragraph
contentPattern.structure: two cells: a thumbnail image, then a date paragraph, an H3 title link, a 'By <author>' paragraph and a teaser paragraph. An optional final row holding only a link labels the Load More button

usage.description: Chronological article feed (Latest Stories): each row shows date, linked title, byline and teaser with a thumbnail on the right.

reuseGuidance: Use for lists of articles or stories. The first five items show initially; a Load More button reveals five more at a time. If the final row is a single link, its text labels the button and the link appears once every item is shown.
